name: 10930 · Highland Mls, NY
findings: ZIP 10930 (Highland Mls) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10930 (Highland Mls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
